title: [UI Tests] Power Display new UI tests

review.body_prefix:
### Qualified current-revision assessment

The complete ten-file change was source-assessed: the E2E lifecycle/flyout/discovery suite, actual Shell icon lookup, signing selection, project/manifest, automation labels, documentation and bounded cold-start connection timeout. All 60 signing-selection fixtures pass independently using the exact revision and complete fixture inputs.

The overlay observation polls the complete HWND set inside the three-second display lifetime before UIA work; simply extending it past dismissal is not an established fix. Brightness writes identify the exact monitor and check persisted state plus rediscovery readback, with restoration in finally. Unsupported virtual hardware is explicitly reported as no physical brightness write exercised.

The author's CI and VM results remain attributed, not our execution receipts. This assessment does not include an independent full product/UI build, live desktop matrix, physical DDC/CI or WMI write, or mixed-monitor signoff. The suite uses English accessible names, including fallback chevron names; the default VM media is English, and localized-shell coverage is not claimed.

No additional required correction is established in the inspected/default-matrix scope. This is a qualified assessment, not fresh zero-finding approval.

The chevron alternatives are Name-only lookups: the NotificationChevron spelling does not implement AutomationId coverage. The fallback accessible names and default VM language scope remain limited; neither localized-shell nor AutomationId fallback behavior is claimed. No independent Shell/UI execution was performed by this reassessment.

The declared MSTest3.8.3 Assert.IsNotNull value parameter is annotated NotNull on every inspected overload, so the assertion supplies nullable flow information. The bounded15-second startup allowance remains the approved cold-start correction; no new configurable timeout or retry change is requested. Current discussion/reviews were reread without an outstanding author request; the author-provided CI/VM evidence remains attributed.
